scopeDimensions.name: primary operator and buyer
scopeDimensions.decision: Compliance/GRC lead or small central team; accountable function owner is buyer/sponsor target; market validation remains not assessed.

scopeDimensions.name: must-win jobs
scopeDimensions.decision: Seven must-win jobs preserve basis, human authority, cross-process work, bounded evidence and verified closure without legal automation.

scopeDimensions.name: seven-process breadth
scopeDimensions.decision: Exactly seven peer business procedures; EP-01 remains cross-cutting; procedure disablement preserves history and evidence.

scopeDimensions.name: deployment topology
scopeDimensions.decision: Customer-controlled single node is primary; loopback default; networked/multi-tenant use remains bounded and conditional; no HA/public-bind claim.

scopeDimensions.name: scale and concurrency
scopeDimensions.decision: Workgroup design envelope: 50 named users/tenant, 10 simultaneous sessions/tenant, 5 tenants/node, 10k active records/tenant, write burst 5; unverified until REALITY/C3.

scopeDimensions.name: supported clients
scopeDimensions.decision: Evergreen Chromium desktop is primary; 390px responsive review/triage is secondary; cross-engine/native/offline/legacy support is out of target.

scopeDimensions.name: install/update/rollback support
scopeDimensions.decision: Versioned local bundle and ictc.sh; planned update/recovery/compatibility-aware rollback; no auto-updater or zero-downtime promise; provenance remains C2.

scopeDimensions.name: data sensitivity/residency
scopeDimensions.decision: Internal/confidential compliance and personal data may occur; customer-controlled local residency is primary; egress changes boundary; universal regulated suitability is not claimed.

scopeDimensions.name: availability/recovery/capacity
scopeDimensions.decision: Business-hours workbench with planned downtime; encrypted verified recovery required; no universal SLA/HA/RTO/RPO; deployment objectives remain E4.

scopeDimensions.name: integrations/master systems
scopeDimensions.decision: Manual/source-pack/external-reference intake, upstream identity, optional AI and same-as-read exports; external master authority retained; no required bidirectional sync.

scopeDimensions.name: roles/delegation/SoD
scopeDimensions.decision: Admin/user/auditor remain; delegation is ownership/assignee/tenant-membership; AI has no decision authority; organization-specific SoD is not universalized.

scopeDimensions.name: product success metrics
scopeDimensions.decision: Repository success uses structural E2 targets while representative time/task/comprehension/AT outcomes require E3; compliance/maturity/market-fit proxy scores are forbidden.

scopeDimensions.name: feature/architecture budget and non-goals
scopeDimensions.decision: Preserve Node/vanilla/Store/SQLite/one-root by default; structural rewrites require REALITY evidence plus DECIDE authority; no second store/global resolver/generic BPM by default.

claimBoundary: SCOPE-0 defines target hypotheses for REALITY-0/C3; it changes no business write authority, API, persistence or AS-IS runtime behavior.
